definitions: Preceding all others of a series or kind; the ordinal of one; earliest.
Most eminent or exalted; most excellent; chief; highest.
A violent collision or compression; a crash; destruction; ruin.
Violent pressure, as of a moving crowd.
To press between two hard objects; to squeeze so as to alter the natural shape or integrity, or to force together into a mass.
To reduce to fine particles by pounding or grinding.

blocks.text: Drake & Josh is an American teen sitcom created by Dan Schneider for Nickelodeon. It aired from January 11, 2004, to September 16, 2007. Two TV films, Drake & Josh Go Hollywood and Merry Christmas, Drake & Josh, were made apart from the regular series that aired on January 6, 2006, and December 5, 2008, respectively. A total of 56 episodes were aired, spanning four seasons. Drake Bell, Josh Peck, and Miranda Cosgrove appeared in all of the episodes.
So Uncool is the debut studio album by American singer and actress Keke Palmer. The album was released on September 18, 2007, by Atlantic Records.
